hero_intro: Photo edits by abdo. Real portraits, reworked in Photoshop.
statement: Every image here started as a real photo of a real person. I take it into Photoshop and build it into something new.

works.title: Raven Swarm
works.description: A figure turned to pure light while a storm of ravens closes in.

works.title: Lone Wanderer
works.description: A lone figure on a misty hillside among giant swords left from an old war.

works.title: Moth Mask
works.description: A pale moth resting over her eyes, with more drifting through the dark.

works.title: Blindfolded in Mist
works.description: Soft light, flowing fabric and a blindfold, toned like an old print.

works.title: Ruined Garden
works.description: The same muse placed in a sunlit garden of broken columns and white flowers.

works.title: Ghostly Triptych
works.description: Three moments of one face blurred together into a single frame.

works.title: Black Water
works.description: Many arms rising out of dark water, hands over her face.

works.title: Ink-Black Water
works.description: The black water piece pushed further into high-contrast black and white.

works.title: A Thousand Faces
works.description: A gritty black-and-white collage of distorted faces, fragmented identities, and chaotic brushstrokes. Harsh contrasts and grainy textures explore inner conflict and the masks we hide behind.

works.title: The Eyes That Follow
works.description: A surreal black-and-white manga scene where a lone figure is surrounded by a suffocating swarm of wide-eyed fish. Grainy textures and heavy inkwork create an unsettling atmosphere of paranoia and claustrophobia.

works.title: Painted Wall
works.description: A street portrait in front of a mural, toned down to warm monochrome.

works.title: Neon Eyes
works.description: Lime hair, yellow eyes and a flash-lit concrete corner.

works.title: Moonlit Violin
works.description: A violinist drifting in a boat, met by a winged figure over glittering water.

works.title: Dreamy Pink Anime Collector Room
works.description: A dreamy pink anime-inspired collector room featuring vibrant neon lighting, detailed displays, and a cozy aesthetic.

works.title: Beneath the Silence
works.description: The dramatic lighting, underwater atmosphere, and flowing fabric make this image a strong featured visual.

works.title: A Room Full of Memories
works.description: The black-and-white treatment, vintage toys, and cinematic lighting make it a distinctive portfolio image.

works.title: The Last Show Tonight
works.description: A lone viewer sits before a vintage television in a vast, nearly black room. The warm glow of a bedside lamp contrasts with the cold light of the screen, while a forgotten VHS tape rests on the floor. A cinematic study of isolation, nostalgia, and the strange comfort of late-night television.

works.title: Love in Ruins
works.description: A raw, punk-inspired editorial portrait blending monochrome tones with striking crimson heart makeup. Messy dark hair, harsh flash lighting, and gritty film textures create a rebellious atmosphere caught between vulnerability and defiance.

works.title: Nothing Left to Fight
works.description: A lone man calmly disintegrates into dust amid a ruined world, with no enemy in sight.

works.title: Crimson Anatomy
works.description: A glowing red x-ray silhouette of a kneeling woman against a pure black background. Fine anatomical details and crimson light create a minimal, haunting atmosphere of stillness and mystery.

about_lead: Photo editor and digital artist working in Photoshop.
about_text:
I take photos of people and edit them: retouching, changing the mood, and sometimes building a whole new scene around them.

Each piece is about keeping the person recognizable while making the image feel like more than a photo.
contact_text: Want your photo edited? Send me a message.
